description: This file defines API endpoints for managing 'Project' resources in a FastAPI application. It includes routes for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting projects, with access control based on user roles and project status. It also contains internal functions for transforming project models into response schemas.

methods.name: ProjectOut _project_to_out(project: Project)
methods.description: Transforms a Project model instance into a ProjectOut schema, including skills.

methods.name: List[ProjectOut] list_projects( db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], current_user: Annotated[Optional[User], Depends(get_current_user)] = None, status_filter: Optional[ProjectStatus] = Query(default=None, alias="status", description="Filter by project status"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list projects with visibility rules based on user authentication and role.

methods.name: ProjectOut create_project( payload: ProjectCreate, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new project owned by the current user, linking skills by ID.

methods.name: ProjectOut get_project( project_id: int, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], current_user: Annotated[Optional[User], Depends(get_current_user)] = None, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a project by ID with access control.

methods.name: ProjectOut update_project( project_id: int, payload: ProjectUpdate, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing project, enforcing ownership or admin privileges.

methods.name: None delete_project( project_id: int, current_user: Annotated[User, Depends(get_current_user)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a project, enforcing ownership or admin privileges.

search-terms: projects list filtered by user role
